kus: KU1. the company’s reporting structure and documentation procedures.
KU2. SOPs, safety and service quality standards followed in the organization.
KU3. how to check connections and fittings of the canopy and identify faulty or damaged
KU4. techniques for assembling and dismantling the canopy wing.
KU5. the use of safety equipment in paragliding/paramotoring/paratrike like harness, helmet,
KU6. the use of two-way radios for communication.
KU8. appropriate clothing and accessories required for the activity.
KU9. process of equipment and service record logbook maintenance.
gs: GS1. be attentive, effective and efficient.
GS2. plan and organize equipment checks on time.

pcs.pc_description: access daily work instructions and activity schedule from the Paragliding/Paramotoring/Paratrike ground crew chief/equipment-in-charge/organizer.

assist the ground crew chief/equipment-in- charge in performing a visual inspection of all components of the wing such as panels, ribs, structural diagonals and straps, plastic rod sleeves, tabs, lines, splices, risers, seams, etc.
ensure to check the condition and numbers of all personal protective equipment like harness, carabiners and helmets carefully and have them ready before the students/clients arrive for the activity.
ensure to maintain a service record and log of any damaged equipment and hand over daily records to ground crew chief/equipment-in-charge/organizer.
assist the ground crew chief/equipment-in- charge to check all the connections and fittings before a flight.
use two-way radios and follow essential communication terms/signals to coordinate with the ground crew chief/equipment-in-charge, when needed.
assist the Tandem Pilot in queuing and anchoring the students/clients based on their weight and weather conditions.
document photos and videos of the activity on action cameras provided by the company.
offer help to persons with disability, when asked for.
empathize with and respect persons with disabilities.

kus: KU1. the manufacturer's recommended equipment maintenance policy.
KU2. proper methods of post activity equipment check and pack up.
KU3. company's documentation procedures including post trip equipment record logbook entries.

modules.module_title: Pack up equipment and submit activity report

pcs.pc_description: ensure to check the condition of all equipment after the activity.
ensure to carefully fold and pack parachute/canopy as well as other equipment and return to the equipment-in-charge/ground crew chief.
maintain a record of the total duration the canopy and equipment was used for.
record loss or damaged equipment in the logbook and submit it to the equipment-in- charge/ground crew chief.
ensure to collect written performance feedback from the equipment-in-charge/ground crew chief/organizer daily.

kus: KU1. organisational policies and procedures to enable safe response to an emergency situation
KU3. call-out procedures to access emergency services personnel.
KU4. use of safety equipment, rescue techniques and basic first-aid methods.
KU5. how to recognize safety signs and symbols.
KU6. how to report actual or potential hazards.
gs: GS1. communicate effectively with the students/clients/team.
GS2. be polite but firm with the students/clients without compromising safety.

modules.module_title: Support in taking safety measures and responding to emergency situations

pcs.pc_description: ensure to keep the operational area protected, safe and hazard free and inform the ground crew chief/equipment-in-charge about any turbulence sources or hazards observed.
ensure to keep the students/clients under observation and away from the operations area.
ensure that Personal Floatation Devices (PFD) are attached to the flying equipment when operating near water.
ensure that first-aid kits, stretchers (spinal board) are easily accessible on the site and provide basic first aid/CPR, if required.
ensure to follow the prescribed emergency action plan and have all emergency equipment at hand in case of an emergency.
ensure to have the radio communication devices ready before/during/after the flight and follow instructions from the ground crew chief/tandem pilot.
maintain calm and be composed in emergency situations.

assist the ground crew chief/equipment-in- charge with establishing communication and coordinating with the tandem pilot/organizer and all third party vendors to provide land and air rescue, in case of an emergency.
support in evacuating students/clients from the danger zone and provide shelter till rescue arrives, in case of disasters.
